expect.description:
Born in a dark, damp cave, Squishy is a low-level slime with an ordinary fate ahead of him: to live and die as an insignificant monster.
However, from the moment of his birth, Squishy was chosen by both magic and the system, awakening as an unusually intelligent slime alongside a livestream...
...And the world he encounters for the first time is far vaster and more wondrous than he ever imagined.
“I want to see it!”
Watching over Squishy are his dependable (?) viewers—Queen Squish, an overprotective Slime Queen, Cheeky Smartie, a lich who loves to tease but always makes sure to share useful knowledge, and even Arachne and Fenrir, who are so smitten with the adorable Squishy that they appoint themselves as his masters.
As he travels the world in his tiny body, fighting, eating, and evolving, Squishy soon finds himself facing new adventures beyond anything he could have imagined.
Here begins an adorable, harmless slime's chaotic journey of survival and exploration!
Will Squishy survive unscathed and get to see the vast, wonderful world he's always dreamed of?
